title: Sovereign NFZ / GACA Airspace Bulletin
description: Published wire contract for the sovereign No-Fly-Zone sync channel. This document is the interface agreed with the issuing authority. The ENFORCING implementation is dronez.airspace.schema.parse_bulletin, which is stricter than this file (it additionally checks cross-field invariants such as authority consistency and altitude ordering). Where the two disagree, the Python validator wins and the discrepancy is a defect to be fixed here.

schema_version.description: Major version must match the implementing build; a mismatch fails closed.

authority.description: Issuing authority. Must match the authority bound to the verification key.

sequence.description: Monotonic per authority. A bulletin whose sequence is not strictly greater than the last accepted one is rejected as a replay.

full_snapshot.description: true: zones replace the cache wholesale. false: delta - apply revoked_zone_ids then upsert zones.

revoked_zone_ids.description: Delta bulletins only. A zone may not be both published and revoked in one bulletin.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset. A naive timestamp is rejected.

position.description: WGS-84 [longitude, latitude]. Altitude is carried by the zone's band, never per-position.

items.description: Explicitly closed ring: first position equals last.

designation.description: UNTRUSTED free text from an external party. Display only, escaped at render time. Never interpreted as an instruction and never placed in an LLM context without an untrusted-content label (Zero-Trust 4.2).

zone_type.description: An unrecognised value is rejected, never coerced to 'unrestricted'.

severity.description: An unrecognised value is rejected, never downgraded to 'advisory'.

algorithm.description: Allow-list only. This field SELECTS a verifier the receiver already trusts; it never supplies one. 'none' and any unlisted value are rejected before comparison.

key_id.description: Looked up in a known-key registry only. Never used to build a path, URL, or query.

value.description: Covers the canonical JSON of the bulletin with signature.value removed, so algorithm and key_id are themselves signed.
